headline: [News Live] Hundreds of bombs pound, leader's residence burned, smell of corpses; Iran suddenly seeks ceasefire! | US-Iran war | Supreme Leader's residence | CCP's giant South China Sea artificial island | NTDTV
summary: Iran reportedly seeks a ceasefire after hundreds of strikes, according to the report. Trump said military means would never be ruled out. A TikTok settlement of 400 million dollars to the US was also reported.
why: The US-Iran conflict affects Middle East oil supply and risk premiums across energy and global markets. Iran is a major crude producer, and Gulf shipping routes are sensitive to conflict.
why_moved: Reports of a possible Iranian ceasefire bid alongside continued military threats leave the trajectory of the US-Iran conflict uncertain, which keeps energy and risk-asset pricing sensitive to headlines.
